connection_fields.name: method
connection_fields.description: how to sign in: oauth (gcloud application-default credentials), service-account (a key file), service-account-json, oauth-secrets or external-oauth-wif

connection_fields.name: project
connection_fields.description: the Google Cloud project to read from (dbt's `database` also works); required, checked by the plugin

connection_fields.name: dataset
connection_fields.description: default dataset for unqualified table names (dbt's `schema` also works)

connection_fields.name: location
connection_fields.description: where jobs run, e.g. US, EU or europe-west2

connection_fields.name: keyfile
connection_fields.description: path to a service account key file, for method service-account

connection_fields.name: keyfile_json
connection_fields.description: a service account key's JSON, inline, for method service-account-json

connection_fields.name: token
connection_fields.description: an OAuth access token, for method oauth-secrets

connection_fields.name: refresh_token
connection_fields.description: an OAuth refresh token, for method oauth-secrets with client_id and client_secret

connection_fields.name: client_id
connection_fields.description: OAuth client ID, for method oauth-secrets with a refresh token

connection_fields.name: client_secret
connection_fields.description: OAuth client secret, for method oauth-secrets with a refresh token

connection_fields.name: token_uri
connection_fields.description: where a refresh token is exchanged (default https://oauth2.googleapis.com/token)

connection_fields.name: workload_pool_provider_path
connection_fields.description: the workload identity pool provider, for method external-oauth-wif

connection_fields.name: token_endpoint
connection_fields.description: where the external identity's token comes from, for method external-oauth-wif: type, request_url, request_data

connection_fields.name: service_account_impersonation_url
connection_fields.description: the service account to impersonate after workload identity federation

connection_fields.name: impersonate_service_account
connection_fields.description: a service account email to run as, using the signed-in identity

connection_fields.name: scopes
connection_fields.description: OAuth scopes (default: bigquery, cloud-platform and drive)

connection_fields.name: execution_project
connection_fields.description: the project jobs run and are billed in, when not `project`

connection_fields.name: quota_project
connection_fields.description: the project API quota is charged to

connection_fields.name: priority
connection_fields.description: interactive (default) or batch

connection_fields.name: maximum_bytes_billed
connection_fields.description: a job that would bill more bytes than this fails instead of running

connection_fields.name: job_execution_timeout_seconds
connection_fields.description: stop a query that runs longer than this

connection_fields.name: job_creation_timeout_seconds
connection_fields.description: give up starting a query after this long

connection_fields.name: retries
connection_fields.description: how many times to try starting the session again after a temporary error (0: never)

connection_fields.name: job_retries
connection_fields.description: how many times a query that fails with a transient error is run again (default 1)

connection_fields.name: job_retry_deadline_seconds
connection_fields.description: stop retrying a query after this long

connection_fields.name: api_endpoint
connection_fields.description: a BigQuery API endpoint other than Google's, e.g. Private Service Connect or an emulator
